Help Center / Plans & billing Choose the right Calendly plan Updated Sep 1, 2026 · 5 min read Available to : Owners and Admins Roles control which account and team settings a person can manage. Your role may vary by organization, team, or group. Plans : All plans Feature access may vary based on your plan , when your account was created, and any add-ons. View plans Calendly offers six plans to fit different scheduling needs: Free — Basic tools for individuals Standard — Advanced scheduling for individuals and small teams Standard Plus — Standard features plus AI meeting management Teams — Team scheduling, lead routing, and admin controls Teams Plus — Teams features plus AI meeting management Enterprise — Security, compliance, and dedicated support for large organizations Each Calendly plan builds on the one before it: the Standard plan includes Free features, the Standard Plus plan includes Standard features, the Teams plan includes Standard features, and the Teams Plus plan includes Teams features, and the Enterprise plan includes Teams features. Visit our pricing page to compare all features . What's included in the Free plan? The Free plan is best for individuals with simple scheduling needs. With the Free plan, you can: Create one event type and schedule unlimited meetings Connect one calendar and use basic integrations Customize your booking page Send confirmation emails Embed your calendar on your website Use the mobile app and browser extension Choose the Free plan if you only need to schedule one type of meeting and don't require integrations beyond your calendar. What's included in the Standard plan? The Standard plan is best for individuals or small teams who need advanced scheduling options. With the Standard plan, you can: Create unlimited event types Connect up to six calendars to be checked for conflicts Use integrations like HubSpot , PayPal , and Stripe Offer group (one host : many invitees) and collective (many hosts : one invitee) events Automate reminders and follow-ups with Automations Customize your emails, booking page, and website embed Get 24/7 live chat support Choose the Standard plan if you need multiple event types, calendar integrations, or Automations but don't yet need team-level lead routing or admin controls. What's included in the Standard Plus plan? The Standard Plus plan is best for individuals who want AI-powered meeting management alongside advanced scheduling. Standard Plus includes all Standard features, plus: Unlimited Notetaker access — Automatic meeting recaps with decisions and action items Callie AI assistant — Coordinate scheduling over email by adding callie@calendly.com to messages Ask Callie in Calendly — Ask questions about your meetings and get answers based on your meeting history Recaps with searchable meeting details — Keep organized records and share them easily Choose the Standard Plus plan if you want to save time on meeting follow-up and get AI meeting context without switching tools. What's included in the Teams plan? The Teams plan is built for teams or individuals who want powerful automation, lead routing, and admin controls. With the Teams plan, you can: Sync meeting data to Salesforce Use round robin scheduling — automatically distribute meetings across team members Route leads with Calendly, Marketo , Pardot , or HubSpot forms Match known leads to the right rep using HubSpot lookup Manage events and permissions with admin tools Add Single Sign-On (SSO) as an optional add-on Get 24/7 live chat support Choose the Teams plan if you or your team need to route leads, distribute meetings across reps, or manage scheduling at the team level. What's included in the Teams Plus plan? The Teams Plus plan is built for teams who want powerful automation, lead routing, admin controls, and AI meeting management. Teams Plus includes all Teams features, plus: Unlimited Notetaker access — Automatic meeting recaps for every team meeting Callie AI assistant — Coordinate scheduling over email and ask questions about meetings Team meeting context — Keep your whole team aligned with shared meeting recaps and action items Pre-drafted follow-ups — Get a head start on next steps from Callie Choose the Teams Plus plan if your team needs lead routing and team automation plus AI tools to reduce meeting admin work. Teams and Teams Plus tiered pricing (annual plans) Learn more Both Teams and Teams Plus offer tiered pricing on annual subscriptions: as your team grows beyond 30 seats, the average price per seat automatically goes down. The first 30 seats remain at the same price. Teams Plus pricing is $8 more per seat per month than Teams at each tier, but follows the same discount model. Seat number Price per seat/month (billed annually) 1-30 $16.00 (Teams) / $24.00 (Teams Plus) 31-50 $14.50 (Teams) / $22.50 (Teams Plus) 51-100 $14.00 (Teams) / $22.00 (Teams Plus) 101-200 $13.50 (Teams) / $21.50 (Teams Plus) 201-300 $13.00 (Teams) / $21.00 (Teams Plus) 301+ $12.00 (Teams) / $20.00 (Teams Plus) For example, if your Teams plan has 40 seats: seats 1–30 cost $16 each per month, and seats 31–40 cost $14.50 each per month. You can add seats and view your total cost anytime from Settings → Billing . Discounts apply automatically. What's included in the Enterprise plan? The Enterprise plan is best for large organizations with advanced security, compliance, and support needs. With the Enterprise plan, you can: Use Single Sign-On (SSO) and advanced user provisioning — automatic user account creation and management through your identity provider Claim your domain and manage all users in one account Access the full Salesforce routing suite Stay compliant with an audit log and data deletion API Get priority support, onboarding, and implementation help Connect to Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Automate Inquire about Notetaker and Callie AI assistant for AI powered meeting management Choose the Enterprise plan if your organization requires SSO, audit logging, dedicated implementation support, or the full Salesforce routing suite. Help Center / Integrations / Calendar connections Quick answer Here’s how to connect your calendar to Calendly so your availability stays in sync and avoids double bookings: In Calendly, go to Availability → Calendar settings. Select + Connect calendar account and choose your calendar type (for example, Google, Outlook/Office 365, or Exchange). Sign in to your calendar account and allow access. Select the calendar(s) Calendly should check for conflicts, and choose where new bookings go. Save your settings and make sure your calendar shows as connected. Once connected, Calendly checks your calendar for busy times and adds new meetings to it. If you connect more than one calendar, choose one as your main calendar for bookings. Was this helpful? Embed options overview Discover how to seamlessly embed Calendly on your website with options like inline, pop-up text, and pop-up widget. Explore tailored instructions for various website providers and learn about advanced customization features for developers. Help Center / Integrations / Embed options Quick answer Calendly offers three embed options: Inline embed – Displays your scheduling page directly within your website. Pop-up text – Opens your scheduling page in a pop-up when a link is clicked. Pop-up widget – Adds a floating button to your page that opens a pop-up when selected. Was this helpful? How to add Calendly to your website Learn how to seamlessly add Calendly to your website with step-by-step instructions. Discover options for embedding, customizing appearance, and integrating with various website providers to enhance user scheduling experiences directly on your site. Help Center / Integrations / Embed options Quick answer To add Calendly to your website: Choose the page you want to embed: * Landing page embed – Displays all active personal or team event types. * Booking page embed – Displays a single event type. Select the three dots (•••) next to your chosen page, then click Add to website . Choose your embed type: inline embed , pop-up widget , or pop-up text. Select Continue , make any adjustments, then click Copy code . Was this helpful? How to troubleshoot unavailable times that should be available Learn how to troubleshoot unavailable times in Calendly using the Troubleshoot Tool. Discover how to identify time-blocking issues, understand troubleshoot codes, and make necessary adjustments to ensure invitees can schedule with you correctly. Help Center / Scheduling / Availability Quick answer To troubleshoot unavailable times that should be available: Open the event type you want to review from your Scheduling page . Select Preview . Click Troubleshoot at the bottom of the preview page. Choose the date and time that appear unavailable but should be open. Review the list of reasons explaining why the time is not available. Was this helpful? How to connect your Google Calendar Learn how to connect your Google Calendar to Calendly to streamline scheduling, prevent double bookings, and automate meeting management. Customize settings for availability checks, event additions, and real-time syncing for an efficient calendar ... Help Center / Integrations / Calendar connections Quick answer To set up your Google Calendar: Go to Settings → Scheduling → Calendars . Select Connect next to Google Calendar . Sign in to your Google account when prompted and return to Calendly. Select which calendars to check under Calendars to check for conflicts and choose a calendar under Calendar to add events to . Was this helpful? How to fine-tune your availability settings Discover how to fine-tune your Calendly availability settings by adjusting time increments, limiting bookings, preventing last-minute appointments, locking time zones, and hiding events. Optimize your scheduling efficiency and manage your time eff... Help Center / Scheduling / Availability Quick answer Here's how to fine-tune your availability: Go to your Scheduling page and select the event type you want to update. Select More options and open the section you want to edit. * Limits and buffers: Set meeting limits and buffer times * Free/busy rules: Choose what this meeting takes priority over * Booking page options: Set start time increments When you’re done, select Save changes . Then check your booking page to make sure it looks right. Was this helpful? How to connect your Office 365 or Outlook.com calendar Learn how to connect your Office 365 or Outlook.com calendar to Calendly for seamless scheduling. Manage availability, prevent double bookings, and customize how Calendly interacts with your calendar to optimize your scheduling experience. Help Center / Integrations / Calendar connections Quick answer To set up your Office 365 or Outlook.com calendar: Go to Settings → Scheduling → Calendars . Select Connect next to Outlook Calendar . Sign in to your Microsoft account when prompted and return to Calendly. Select which calendars to check under Calendars to check for conflicts and choose a calendar under Calendar to add events to . Was this helpful? How to use buffers Learn how to effectively use buffer times in Calendly to enhance meeting prep and reduce stress. Customize buffer settings for each event type, manage visibility on your calendar, and ensure smooth scheduling without overlaps. Help Center / Scheduling / Availability Quick answer Here’s how to add time before or after meetings using buffers: Go to the Scheduling page and select the event type you want to edit. Select More options , then Limits and buffers. Select + Set buffer time . Add your preferred buffer time before and/or after the meeting. Select Save changes . Your buffer changes will apply to new bookings and help prevent back-to-back meetings. Was this helpful? How to add Calendly to a WordPress site Learn how to seamlessly embed Calendly on your WordPress site with this step-by-step guide. Discover methods for both WordPress.com and WordPress.org users, including inline embeds and pop-ups to enhance booking capabilities. Help Center / Integrations / Embed options Quick answer Here's how to add your Calendly scheduler to a WordPress site: Get your embed code — In Calendly, select the three dots next to event type or landing page you want to share and select Add to website . Choose how you want it to appear, then select Copy code . Open your WordPress dashboard and go to the page where you want the scheduler to appear. Add a Custom HTML block (or Custom HTML widget) and paste the Calendly embed code. Select Publish or Update, then preview the page to confirm the scheduler displays correctly. If your plan doesn't support HTML embeds, you can add a link to your Calendly scheduling page instead. Was this helpful? How to set meeting limits Learn how to set meeting limits in Calendly to prevent overbooking and manage your availability effectively. Control bookings per specific event or across all events, ensuring you maintain time for other priorities while managing your schedule. Help Center / Scheduling / Availability Quick answer Here's how to set up meeting limits: Go to your Scheduling page and open the Event Type you want to edit. Select More options , then find Limits and buffers . Turn on Meeting limits and choose how many times this Event Type can be booked per day, week, or month. Save your changes so the limits apply. The next time someone books this Event Type, Calendly will enforce the limits you set. Was this helpful? Help Learn Menu Search Chat

jsonld_parsed.name: Add Notetaker and Callie to  Standard or Teams plans
jsonld_parsed.description: Get meeting recaps and action items, plus an AI assistant to help with the work around meetings.

mainEntity.name: What happens at the end of my trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: At the end of your 14-day trial, you'll automatically be downgraded to the Free tier and you’ll be able to continue to use Calendly as long as you’d like. If you decide to upgrade to a paid plan, you can do so from the billing page in your account at any time during or after your trial.

mainEntity.name: Which plan is best for me and my team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose based on how much work around your meetings you want Calendly to handle. Standard and Teams focus on automating scheduling. Standard Plus and Teams Plus add Notetaker for meeting recaps, action items, and follow-up support, and Callie for email scheduling coordination and meeting prep and recall in Calendly. Enterprise adds admin, security, and scale for larger organizations, with tailored AI capabilities.

mainEntity.name: Can we try Calendly with multiple users?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! You can invite team members to join your trial account at no cost. At the end of your 14-day trial, all members will be automatically downgraded to the Free plan.

mainEntity.name: What does the renewal process look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paid subscriptions automatically renew for the same subscription period unless you downgrade your plan before your renewal date.

mainEntity.name: How do I upgrade or downgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visit your billing page by going to My Account > Billing. From there, you can change your plan, add or remove user seats, and update your payment information.

mainEntity.name: We’re a non-profit organization, is there special pricing available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer special pricing to qualified non-profit organizations. Contact our customer support specialists for details: support@calendly.com

mainEntity.name: What payment methods do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, and Diners Club credit and debit cards. Payment via PayPal is accepted for customers located outside the United States. Payment via invoice is available on the Standard or Teams plan for $5,000 and Enterprise plan for $15,000.
